system.description:
Your "Shield Pact" grants an additional +10 to the intensity of [Cancel]. Your "Swashbuckler" grants an additional +20 to the intensity of [Barrier]. Force Field Shield A shield created using the secret Alve technique. Though it appears small and weak, it can expand a transparent force field by chanting a keyword, protecting you. Unlike regular shields, it doesn't block the view, making it highly sought after by shield users. It provides powerful defensive capabilities. High Light Shield Slot

Multi-Chain Circuit [Core Material] (300G) + Kite Shield (220G) + White Hitokata (Intermediate) (230G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 13] (170G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (450G)
